As Apple (AAPL) Share Price Rose, Valiant Capital Management LP Cut Holding; As Fiserv (FISV) Market Valuation Declined, Covington Investment Advisors Has Boosted by $3.36 Million Its Position
June 6, 2018 - By Henry Gaston
Christopher R. Hansen decreased its stake in Apple Inc (AAPL) by 80.94% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Valiant Capital Management Lp sold 1.62 million shares as the company’s stock rose 5.37% while stock markets declined. The hedge fund run by Christopher R. Hansen held 381,300 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $63.98M, down from 2.00M at the end of the previous reported quarter. Valiant Capital Management Lp who had been investing in Apple Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $946.56 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 0.38% or $0.73 during the last trading session, reaching $192.58. About 4.21M shares traded. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 22.56% since June 6, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 9.99% the S&P500. Covington Investment Advisors Inc increased its stake in Fiserv Inc (FISV) by 101.38% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Covington Investment Advisors Inc bought 47,303 shares as the company’s stock declined 1.25% with the market. The institutional investor held 93,961 shares of the technology company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $6.70M, up from 46,658 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Covington Investment Advisors Inc who had been investing in Fiserv Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $30.98B market cap company. The stock increased 1.31% or $0.98 during the last trading session, reaching $75.66. About 700,425 shares traded. Fiserv, Inc. (NASDAQ:FISV) has risen 15.27% since June 6, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 2.70% the S&P500.
Analysts await Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) to report earnings on August, 7. They expect $2.19 EPS, up 31.14% or $0.52 from last year’s $1.67 per share. AAPL’s profit will be $10.76 billion for 21.98 P/E if the $2.19 EPS becomes a reality. After $2.73 actual EPS reported by Apple Inc. for the previous quarter, Wall Street now forecasts -19.78% negative EPS growth.
Valiant Capital Management Lp, which manages about $3.29 billion and $1.09B US Long portfolio, upped its stake in Facebook Inc (NASDAQ:FB) by 62,300 shares to 364,023 shares, valued at $58.17M in 2018Q1, according to the filing.
